endorsements.quote: Developing metrics for scribe‐mediated data quality will require defining what accurate documentation looks like in practice, likely through structured clinician review against source audio, patient‐reported accuracy under open notes frameworks, and comparison against established documentation standards such as those used in medical audits.
Investment in internal informatics capacity; structured rollout protocols; staged approval processes (“scribe formularies”).

unlisted_practices: Establish AI Documentation Stewardship Committees to oversee ambient scribe documentation quality.
Maintain hybrid documentation options and reversible integration pathways for ambient scribes.
Provide clinician-facing error dashboards for ambient scribe documentation errors.
Integrate scribe metadata into quality systems.
Adopt policies on retention, governance, and permissible use of source audio recordings from clinical encounters, balancing quality assurance against patient privacy.
Require vendors to provide model-agnostic labeling standards, required telemetry reporting, and contractual transparency obligations.
Establish regulatory frameworks for post-market monitoring and reporting standards for AI documentation tools.
Conduct longitudinal studies of demographic disparities in ambient scribe performance.
Involve patients in quality assessment of ambient scribe notes, including through open notes.

screen.reason: This is a commentary/perspective outlining a governance agenda and infrastructural framework for ambient AI scribes in learning health systems.
